views.what_it_constrains: The planar profile of the handle (inverted U-shape), defining the bend radius and leg lengths.
The cross-section of the handle, defining the circular profile and diameter.
The side elevation, confirming the height and curvature.

parts.description: A single continuous rod bent into an inverted U-shape.

relations.description: The circular cross-section is swept along the path defined by the two straight legs and the semi-circular bend.

symmetry.description: The object is symmetric about the vertical plane bisecting the handle.

repetitions.description: Two identical straight legs extending downwards.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: The 'top' view in the drawing actually depicts the front elevation (inverted U), while the 'end section' depicts the cross-section. The CAD mapping assumes the inverted U is the primary profile plane.
interpretation_conflicts: The label 'TOP (XY)' is placed above the inverted U view, but geometrically this view represents the front face (XZ plane) of the object relative to the sweep direction. The 'END SECTION' represents the cross-section.
generation_notes: The object is a standard handle. The geometry is fully defined by the sweep of a circle (d=8mm) along a path consisting of two straight segments (L=30mm) and a semi-circle (R=20mm). The maximum dimension is the total height (30mm leg + 20mm radius = 50mm) or width (40mm + 8mm = 48mm).

unresolved_constraints: The 'top' view in the drawing actually depicts the front elevation (inverted U), while the 'end section' depicts the cross-section. The CAD mapping assumes the inverted U is the primary profile plane.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
